prompt:
Paint ONE lighthouse for a top-down pixel-art JRPG world map (overworld), in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the tall tower is seen from the front and slightly above, standing on a small cluster of dark sea-worn cape rocks. The first attached image is an exact layout guide at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the rocks at the bottom, the round tapering tower with three broad red bands on white (like a classic painted lighthouse), the dark iron gallery ring with a railing, the glass lantern room (the yellow block, with thin dark iron mullions), the dark blue-slate domed cap with a small iron finial and weather vane, and the arched wooden door at the base (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through). Two tiny dark slit windows on the tower. A few stone steps and a little moss and sea-salt stains on the rocks. The second attached image shows the painted look of the harbour town nearby (its small red-and-white lighthouse on a rock is the model for this one): match that palette and rendering, but at the size and layout of the guide. The lantern glass is a warm pale amber (the lamp inside), the rest is plain base colour. The whole image is 112 x 208 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light beams, NO glow halos, NO light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting and the lamp glow on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No sea, no grass, no ground outside the rocks, no shadow, no people, no birds, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Create ONE standalone lighthouse game sprite based closely on the two user-attached reference images. Reference 1 is the STRICT compositional silhouette/layout guide: portrait aspect 112:208, narrow tall rounded tapering tower, three thick red horizontal bands separated by white, small dark blue-slate round domed lantern roof and tiny finial/weather vane, amber glazed lantern behind narrow iron mullions, dark iron gallery rail, precisely positioned and sized arched dark-brown WALK-THROUGH DOOR at bottom center, two tiny dark slit windows above, low rocky cape at bottom. Reference 2 gives the rendering and warm earthy palette of a classic red-white lighthouse at harbor, not its broader rocks or view angle. Produce premium modern hi-bit handcrafted pixel art JRPG overworld sprite, classic 3/4 top-down perspective (front and slightly above). Crisp consistently sized square art pixels and hard stepped edges, clusters of 3–10 pixels, no antialiasing, no blur, no noise, no dithering. 4–6 colors each material, subtly warm yellow highlights and purple-red shadows. Modest stone steps at door, sparing moss and salt staining on clustered dark sea-worn rocks. Neutral soft even overcast base color lighting from upper left. Amber color ONLY inside lantern glass: NO glow, halo, beams, illuminated ground, cast shadows, or nighttime grading. Fully transparent background (magenta in reference 1 means transparency), isolated sprite only. NO ocean, land, sky, background, people, birds, writing or extra objects. Match exact portrait proportions of first reference, with rocks filling bottom and no excessive empty padding.
